title: Participles: who does it
summary: Describe people and things with a whole action before the noun: `-ýAn` for what is going on (*kitap okaýan oglan*), `-An` for what has happened (*düýn gelen myhman*), with the possessive on the noun when it is the thing done (*meniň okan kitabym*, *işleýän ýerim*), participles as nouns (*gelenler*, *aýdanyň*), and everything in its place before the noun.
canDo: Point out and describe people by what they are doing or have done
Talk about the book you read, the place you work, the song you like best
Say who came, who knows, and what someone said or saw
Build long descriptions in Turkmen order
